title: Sod's shock tube
shows: A diaphragm at the middle of a tube bursts (ρ, p = 1, 1 left of it and 0.125, 0.1 right, γ = 1.4). At t = 0.2 the exact solution has p* = 0.30313 and u* = 0.92745 between the rarefaction and the shock, density 0.42632 left of the contact and 0.26557 right of it.
source: G. A. Sod, J. Comput. Phys. 27 (1978) 1–31; the exact Riemann solution: E. F. Toro, Riemann Solvers and Numerical Methods for Fluid Dynamics, 3rd ed. (2009), ch. 4.
